Messages.Author: Derek Rawlings
Messages.Body:
Minions A and B are in combat.

Minion A plays Carrion Crows (at basic), and strikes for strength damage

Minion B strikes for strength damage, and plays Skin of Steel to prevent
damage from all of his opponents strikes this round.

How much damage, if any, does Minion B take. Does he:

1) Take no damage

2) Take 1 damage, since Crows are not a strike made by the opposing
minion.

Derek
